THE FUTURE HAD A FEATHERED FRIEND.

Some ideas arrive
a little too early.

In the 1990s, researchers imagined computers you could simply talk to. One of those dreams took the form of a parrot.

Persona is our independent love letter to that idea: a friendly presence with a personality, a memory, and a reason to come back.

1993

The original dream

Microsoft Research’s Persona project explored animated conversational interfaces. Peedy the Parrot could help people choose music and ask follow-up questions.

Watch the original research ↗
1997 → 2009

A familiar face on the desktop

Microsoft Agent brought programmable characters and speech to applications. Microsoft later discontinued the platform with Windows 7.

Read the original announcement ↗
NOW

A familiar character. A new chapter.

The original Peedy artwork, a fresh personality, and an optional language model that runs on your own device. This is a community interpretation, not restored Microsoft software.

A COMMUNITY WITH A LITTLE CHARACTER.

Come for the bird.
Stay for the revival.

A forgotten-future companion,
with a community building its next chapter.

$PERSONA is the working identity for our memecoin community concept. Peedy is free to meet. Holding a token is not required to use the companion.
